thread:
jia: ran a robustness sweep for sentinel-embed-v1 across short-tail / long-tail / clustered queries — dropping notes here.

eval-bot: eval summary uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/sentinel/sweep-2850001234/report.html :mag:

jia: topline: recall@10 — short-tail: baseline 0.842 -> sentinel 0.811 (-3.1pp). long-tail 0.562 -> 0.559 (stable). clustering cohesion decreased on ~7% of shards.

omar: did you test fp16 vs quantized variants? wondering if this is a quantization sensitivity.

jia: baseline is fp16. sentinel is shipped with float16 and we tried a post-training 6-bit symmetric quant (per-tensor). short-tail dropped mostly with quant. logs below.

jia: ```
$ python eval_embeds.py --model sentinel-embed-v1 --sets shorttail,longtail,clustered --quantize symmetric-6bit
[INFO] loading model: sentinel-embed-v1 fp16
[INFO] applying quantization: symmetric-6bit per-tensor
[RESULT] shorttail recall@10: 0.811
[RESULT] longtail recall@10: 0.559
[DEBUG] mean_vector_norm: baseline 1.02 -> quant 0.78
```

kyle: short-tail = product "suggest" queries, right? a lot of 1-3 token inputs. could be SNR issue where small contexts get flattened.

jia: exactly. ran a quick SNR-by-length calc, tokens<=3 show ~12% drop in SNR after quant. longer queries unaffected.

marta: did you try normalizing before quant vs after? that sometimes helps with dynamic range.

jia: tried both. pre-quant L2-normalize then quant gives slightly better recall than normalizing post-quant. hypothesis: normalize first avoids range collapse that quant destroys.

omar: next experiments to try: per-channel quantization, 5-bit symmetric, and compare distance metric (cosine vs dot). also try tiny calibration on short-tail data.

jia: mapping out next jobs: 1) per-channel 5-bit sweep, 2) product-quant (PQ) fallback test, 3) cosine vs dot recall comparison, 4) umap centroid drift visualization for clustered shards, 5) small calibration pass on short-tail.

eval-bot: queue updated: 6 jobs added (per-channel-5bit, pq-fallback, cosine-dot, snr-by-len, umap-centroid-visuals, calibration-proto). ETA ~6h.

sophia: if you need quick dev GPU for the per-channel trials, ping me and I can spin up a small pool on dev-gpu:low.

jia: will do — thanks. i also plan to add a tiny synthetic perturbation test (add noise to short queries) to verify robustness threshold. posting results and artifact links when jobs finish. TL;DR: sentinel-embed-v1 shows a measurable short-tail recall regression that looks quantization-sensitive; follow-up sweeps planned. :white_check_mark:
